visible_dialog_text_summary: Sysplorer 遇到错误，需要关闭。
已经产生相关错误报告，不包含任何隐私信息。
Dialog offers copy report path, add/delete attachments, restart program, send error report, and confirm.
external_path_handling: Do not read or copy the external MWORKS report path unless the user explicitly asks. Record the visible path prefix and ask the department to return the full report path if it is copied through official UI.
required_department_behavior: Stop the current Sysplorer/MWORKS MCP sequence when this dialog is observed.
Do not continue solver/model trial-and-error while the GUI error dialog is open.
Do not click restart, send error report, or confirm/close without PMO/user approval unless the task explicitly authorizes cleanup.
Write a blocker packet with screenshot path, visible dialog text, triggering command/action, report path or visible prefix, whether Sysplorer would restart, and next safe recovery step.
If a department caused the dialog, it must return the blocker to PMO instead of silently retrying.
current_claim_boundary: This incident does not invalidate already saved MWORKS evidence by itself.
No new MWORKS GUI/MCP claim should be made after the dialog appeared until the session is recovered and the smallest relevant check_model passes again.
Do not classify this as a code/model bug without reading the MWORKS error report or reproducing after GUI/session recovery.
